How It Works

How Bulk SMS works in Kenya

From registration to live delivery, here is what working with MobiWave looks like.

  1. 1

    Sign up and verify your business

    Register with your Kenyan business registration, KRA PIN and a contact at +254 736 427 842. We verify and activate your account within one business day.

  2. 2

    Register your sender ID on all three networks

    We handle CAK-aligned Sender ID registration with Safaricom, Airtel and Telkom on your behalf at no extra admin fee. Most sender IDs are approved in 1–3 business days.

  3. 3

    Test in the sandbox

    Use our sandbox to send test SMS to approved test numbers, validate webhooks, and verify your templates. Switch to production keys when you are ready.

  4. 4

    Send your first campaign

    Send via REST API, our web dashboard, or scheduled recurring triggers. Watch delivery status stream in real time to a webhook or our reporting dashboard.

  5. 5

    Scale with volume pricing

    As monthly volume grows, your per-SMS rate steps down automatically across our tiered plans. Enterprise customers get a dedicated account manager and 24/7 priority support.

  6. 6

    Bundle with M-Pesa, WhatsApp and USSD

    Add native M-Pesa STK Push, WhatsApp Business API, USSD menus or airtime rewards from the same MobiWave account — one billing line, one support contact.

Frequently Asked Questions

Bulk SMS questions, answered.

The practical questions Kenyan organisations ask about bulk sms, with straight answers and KES pricing where it applies.

Still have a question? Talk to us →

MobiWave charges from KES 0.20 to KES 0.35 per SMS depending on monthly volume. The Small Business tier (1–50,000 SMS/month) is KES 0.35, Medium (50,001–500,000) is KES 0.30, Large (500,001–2M) is KES 0.25, and Enterprise (2M+) is KES 0.20. Pricing is per-network and inclusive of sender ID registration. There are no setup fees and no admin fees.
